name: XSL Map Selective Rendering
definition: A perceptual strategy for physically based rendering of participating media that reduces rendering times by using a combination of a saliency map (S map), an extinction map (X map), and a light map (L map) to guide selective rendering, providing more accurate estimates in perceptually important areas.
summary: XSL Map Selective Rendering reduces rendering time by using a director map to prioritize perceptually important areas, addressing artifacts from poor sampling around light sources.
